subject: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-09T15:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. To make the upcoming technical demo productive for both Sentinel Bank and Redwood, we'd like to schedule a short 45–60 minute session that includes: AE (commercial overview), SE (technical demo / Q&A), and any procurement/security reps who want to review controls and contract checkpoints.

I know coordinating across US / EU / APAC is painful, so rather than a single time that always favors one region, we propose a small rotating cadence so each timezone gets one friendly slot in the pilot schedule. Initial proposal (UTC and local approximations):

- Option A: 15:00–16:00 UTC (08:00–09:00 PDT / 18:00–19:00 CEST) — US morning / EU evening overlap
- Option B: 00:00–01:00 UTC (17:00–18:00 JST / 09:00–10:00 PDT) — APAC friendly
- Option C: 06:00–07:00 UTC (22:00–23:00 AEST previous day / 02:00–03:00 CEST) — fallback for deep-APAC execs

Can you confirm who from your side must attend (security, procurement, CE)? I attached a simple availability grid (availability-grid.xlsx) to help map recurring times. If any of these options work, reply with preferred slots or send back your procurement availability PDF and we’ll seed real invites.

Goal: run a 2-week pilot with 3 demos (one per region time preference) so your engineers see the product at a convenient hour at least once. If that sounds OK, I’ll loop in our SE (Karthik) and put calendar placeholders on hold while y’all confirm.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@sentinelbank.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T23:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the thoughtful approach. Sentinel will want procurement and our security lead on the first call: Priya Shah (security) and Procurement (procurement@sentinelbank.com). For engineer availability, the team is flexible but prefers EU-friendly times. Option A (15:00 UTC / 16:00 CEST) looks promising for our engineers this week on Tue/Wed.

Procurement forward-declared that they prefer late afternoons CEST or early US mornings — I've attached a quick capture of their availability (procurement-availability.pdf).

Also: we will need a SOC2 summary up front and an outline of data handling before we run internal approvals — could you include that?

If possible, book two pilot demos: one this week at an EU-friendly time and one next week at a US-friendly time. That will help expedite review.

Thanks,
Alex
Lead Engineer — Platform Integrations
Sentinel Bank
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-10T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Hi Alex / Tessa —

Thanks — Karthik here (SE). A couple of quick notes from the technical side:

1) If we run a 45–60m demo, I recommend the following agenda: 10m intro, 25m live demo with a short integration example (embedding + retrieval + live inference), 20m Q&A / security + procurement questions.
2) For procurement/security: I can bring a short (5–7 slide) security slide deck and our SOC2 summary. I’ll attach the SOC2 summary to the invite.
3) Practical ask: can you confirm whether demos will run from a corporate network that requires IP allowlisting? If yes, share the dev VPC IP ranges and we’ll provide endpoints to whitelist.

On rotation mechanics — we typically do a three-week pilot where each demo is scheduled with a different timezone bias so all stakeholder groups get a friendly slot. Proposed pilot schedule (UTC):
- Demo 1 (EU-friendly): 2028-07-11T15:00:00Z
- Demo 2 (US-friendly): 2028-07-18T16:00:00Z
- Demo 3 (APAC-friendly): 2028-07-25T23:00:00Z

If those dates/times look reasonable I’ll prepare calendar invites and attach the SOC2 summary + a short MAP draft.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: procurement@sentinelbank.com
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-11T09:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Tessa / team —

Procurement here. Thanks for the draft schedule. A few notes:
- We need the mutual-action-plan (MAP) doc for legal to review before any contractual discussions. Could you route a DocuSign link or a shared Drive doc?
- The first demo on 2028-07-11 at 15:00 UTC conflicts with a standing audit prep call for part of our team. Can you shift the EU-friendly demo earlier by 90 minutes (i.e., 13:30–14:30 UTC) or move it to Wed 2028-07-12?
- For PO processing we need approximate monthly consumption figures and expected SAML / provisioning timeline.

Attached: a short procurement availability note (we already emailed a capture to Alex).

Regards,
Sentinel Bank Procurement
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>, procurement@sentinelbank.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-12T02:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Alex / Procurement —

Thanks — understood on the audit conflict. Proposed update and next steps:

1) Updated pilot plan (two-week compact pilot, rotating friendly windows):
   - Demo A (EU-friendly): 2028-07-12 13:30–14:30 UTC (14:30–15:30 CEST) — moved per procurement note
   - Demo B (US-friendly): 2028-07-18 16:00–17:00 UTC (09:00–10:00 PDT)
   - Demo C (APAC-friendly): 2028-07-25 23:00–00:00 UTC (08:00–09:00 JST next day)

2) Attachments included: MAP_v1.docx (seed mutual action plan), SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf, demo-invite.ics (calendar placeholders). I placed tentative holds on our side; please confirm and I’ll switch holds to real Google Calendar invites.

3) DocuSign / legal: If Procurement sends a preferred DocuSign envelope or a shared Drive edit link, we’ll queue it to Legal for fast review.

4) Karthik will bring the security slides and a short architecture diagram to the demo. Karthik: please confirm IP allowlist ranges if needed so Sentinel can set firewall rules ahead of Demo A.

If you can confirm the attendees (names + emails) for each session I will finalize invites and include the MAP v1 in the invite body for easy access.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@sentinelbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, procurement@sentinelbank.com
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@sentinelbank.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-12T11:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rotate demo windows to align US / EU / APAC engineers

Thanks — that updated plan works. Confirming attendees for Demo A (2028-07-12 13:30 UTC):
- Alex Wu (Platform Integrations)
- Priya Shah (Security Lead)
- procurement@sentinelbank.com (PO rep)

Priya: can you confirm if you need any additional artifacts ahead of the session (data flow diagram, retention policy)? If not, we’ll accept the SOC2 summary and MAP_v1 in the invite.

Karthik — please include a short architecture diagram in the invite attachments. If we need IP ranges I’ll coordinate with our network team and update procurement.

See you all on the call.

Best,
Alex
